$comment: Public Ed25519 keys (PEM SPKI) whose signatures the release gates accept. Roles: owner (P0 register, trial pre-registration), security-reviewer (independent security review), certification (harness certification records), calibration (the reviewer-signed calibration release). Adding a key is a reviewed commit by the repository owner; RELEASING.md describes key generation (scripts/release-evidence.mjs keygen) and rotation. No key is trusted until it is listed here.
